'''Maires''' was the [[Mairan/Legends|Mairan]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. It was an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]].<ref name="Lightsabers" />
